description:
Get Tripadvisor Place Details

Fetches one Tripadvisor place by its numeric place ID (the `placeId` returned by the Tripadvisor Search API, or the number after `-d` or `-g` in a Tripadvisor URL) and returns `placeResult`, whose fields depend on its `type`. Every place carries name, link, description, rating, review count, ranking, photos, address, phone, website, email and GPS coordinates where Tripadvisor shows them. Hotels add star class, award, styles, subratings, prices by booking provider with the quoted dates, price range, amenities, room features and types, languages spoken, room count, walk score, an AI review summary with highlights, and nearby transit, airports, hotels, restaurants and attractions. Attractions add categories, duration, ticket price, opening hours, neighborhood, how to get there, featured tours, and nearby places; tours (attraction products) add highlights, languages, meeting point, inclusions, exclusions and the operator. Destinations add travel advice (tips and questions), suggested hotels, restaurants and attractions, itineraries, articles, guides, themed collections, related destinations and an FAQ. Use it to enrich search results, build travel and hospitality datasets, or monitor hotel prices and ratings.

domain.description: Tripadvisor domain to use. The domain sets the language of the results. Default is `www.tripadvisor.com`.

placeId.description: Tripadvisor place ID, as returned by the Tripadvisor Search API. Works for destinations, hotels, attractions, tours and restaurants.
